info.name: AEGIS Internal API
info.description:
AEGIS — advisory short-swing crypto signals (Phase 1). Private read API.

**Advisory only.** No endpoint places, modifies, or cancels orders (constitution C-1). This API is private (loopback / VPN); never expose it to the public internet (AC-07).

## Setup
1. Import this collection.
2. Open the collection variables and set `baseUrl` and `apiKey` (matches `AEGIS_API_KEY` in your `.env`).
3. All requests except `health` send `X-API-Key` automatically via collection-level auth.

Figures in responses are Decimal strings (e.g. `"2.00000000"`) — the deterministic source of truth (C-2).

variable.description: Dev: uvicorn on loopback. Behind Caddy/TLS in prod it is https://localhost/api/v1 (via VPN).
UUID of a signal (fill from a /signals response)

request.description: Liveness/readiness. Public, but only reachable on the private network (AC-07). Returns `{"status":"ok"}`.
List signals (most recent first). Requires X-API-Key. Drop the `status` query to list all.
Single signal with thesis, bull/bear case, invalidation, confidence and status. 404 if unknown.
The executable (advisory) order ticket: entry/TP/SL, OCO|TP_SL|MARKET_TRAILING, size, target_exchange, validity. NEVER placed (C-1). 404 if no ticket.

}

request.description: Loopback-only. The AI layer posts a decided signal here AFTER the deterministic reconciliation. The endpoint re-verifies every figure against the persisted candidate: **409** on mismatch (no hallucinated number reaches the operator — AC-04 / C-2), **404** if the candidate is unknown, **201** on success. `candidate_id` must reference a candidate produced by the deterministic engine; figures must equal it exactly.
